finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: stackSize is too large, causing memory allocation failure or buffer overflow
finding.assumptions: The stackSize parameter is not validated to ensure it does not exceed available memory or cause overflow.

finding.title: Use After Free
finding.trigger: If the stack is full and push is called again, it will write to a freed memory location
finding.assumptions: The stack does not handle the case where push is called when the stack is full.

finding.title: Null Pointer Dereference
finding.trigger: If pop is called on an empty stack, it will dereference a null pointer
finding.assumptions: The stack does not handle the case where pop is called on an empty stack.

finding.title: Integer Overflow
finding.trigger: If stackSize is very large, it can cause integer overflow, leading to incorrect memory allocation
finding.assumptions: The stackSize parameter is not validated to prevent integer overflow.
